transcript.content: Benjamin, I respect your independence and I don’t want to tell you what to do, but because we share values and I care about your well-being, would you hear me out for a few minutes? transcript.content: Thank you, Benjamin — I appreciate you hearing me out and I completely respect that your happiness and choices come first. If any of those feel off in a relationship, it’s worth pausing and asking more questions, and I’m here to talk through any specifics if you ever want to.
